name: Fabrication Toolkit K2
description: Fabrication Toolkit modified for K2 (outline origin, assembly PDF)
description_full:
Modified version of bennymeg/Fabrication-Toolkit for the K2 factory.

 Changes: 
• Uses the bottom-left of the board outline (Edge.Cuts) as origin (0,0) for Gerber, drill and position files. 
• Writes origin.txt with origin location and board size. 
• Generates assembly drawings (top/bottom PDF) from the Fab layers. 

 Original: https://github.com/bennymeg/Fabrication-Toolkit
